example.title: Broadway Housing (affordable housing, Koning Eizenberg)
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A late-1990s affordable-housing block: two small blocks, one of olive-ochre stucco with a tilted angular zinc-clad roof form, one clad in silver corrugated metal with a sloped dormer, linked by an open steel stair and walkways. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
